usedFor: Advogalia is the legal platform that holds a firm's clients and cases, and HubSpot holds its marketing contacts. A “New Client” in Advogalia can run “Update Contact” in HubSpot to bring that person's record up to date.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client” in Advogalia, then “Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new client is when a HubSpot contact should change. The action finds the contact by email, so no duplicate record is created.

watchOut: “Update Contact” finds the contact by its email, so the person must already exist in HubSpot with that address. The three Advogalia triggers are polling.
